Manage Topics News Xbox GTA 6 Rockstar Games Grand Theft Auto Here's Another 30+ New GTA 6 Screenshots To Drool Over Now that's a fine batch of photos by Craig Reid 6 hours ago Share: Someone at Rockstar is clearly having fun with the photo mode in GTA 6 . Hopefully, all these extra screenshots mean the game will actually feature one, because by golly gosh, this latest batch of pics is gorgeous! 'The Launch Gallery' features 38 new screenshots from GTA 6 which show off the insane level of unique detail and vast range of characters we'll likely encounter when the game launches November 19th. We've spotted some a few thirst traps amongst the vast range of gun-pointing scowls. There's loads to feast your eyes on, so take a look! It can't be helped when the game looks this good and we've been waiting so long! Judging by the new screenshots, GTA 6 is going to consume so much of our spare time come November 19. GTA 6 preloading begins for Xbox Series X|S on November 10th and will take up around 212GB. Best to prepare room for the game ahead of launch because that's one hefty download! I have my flight booked to New Zealand to play it early. 2 5 Fiendish-Beaver 6 hours ago I'm not intending to buy the game, but the screenshots are very impressive. My son absolutely loved GTA 5, so I imagine that he will get it, and as we game share on the Xbox I will have the opportunity to play it should I be persuaded to do so. I do have to say, I wonder whether it will live up to the hype, and also whether it will get fantastic 10/10 reviews whilst at the same time numerous issues with the game are pointed out? I wonder whether professional reviewers will feel compelled to give the game 10/10s, or whether it will deserve them, and whether those same issues in another game would see it marked down? In other words, is the game too big to be critiqued properly? I'm sure the game will be good, but will it be as good as we will be led to believe? I hope it is for the sake of all those that are really looking forward to it, but as someone on the outside of the hype, the excitement is kind of bewildering. To me, it's a bit like everyone raving about the latest Artic Monkeys album, when I just don't like their music and I cannot understand how anyone does... 😉 1 6 AI-Generation 5 hours ago All at a beautiful 30fps.
